It's been going on for a few weeks.

I have less feeling in my right arm.
I have pain in my right arm.

I've been drinking regularly for a long time. I have 2 to 7 alcoholic drinks a day.

opening.text: My right arm has been weak for a few weeks, and it's gotten so bad that I drop things. I have less feeling in my right arm and I have pain in it too. I've also lost a lot of weight recently, and I don't know why. I have diabetes, and I've been drinking regularly for a long time, having 2 to 7 alcoholic drinks a day. I'm a heavy smoker; I've smoked 2 packs of cigarettes a day since I was 25.
